title: How long does a habit take to form?

probes.question: What does the range of 18 to 254 days tell us?
options: People differ a lot in how long a habit takes

probes.question: True or false: in simple models, automaticity rises with repetition up to a plateau, and that process can be slow.

image.alt: A brown leather diary with a gold 2026 on the cover lies on a light wooden table.

body.question: On average, how many days did it take people in Lally and colleagues' study to make a new behaviour automatic?
body.reveal: The average was 66 days, but the range was wide: from 18 to 254 days. Habits form on different timelines for different people.
